sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Control is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello-hello. I've got a new job for you. There's been a lot of talk lately about those so-called laboratories. I don't like all this commotion, especially all the pillagers dragging whatever they can get their hands on out of those places. Head down there and thin their ranks. Make an example of them so others think twice before following in their footsteps. Do it quickly, or they won't get the message."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Jaeger to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 10 targets in The Lab (in one raid)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000EXP
- +4 Throwables skill levels
- Jaeger Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- Unlocks barter for Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant MRS) at Jaeger LL4
"I've already heard rumors of what you did. Keep it up."
